task_name: Check 'Busy Manufacturing' Journal, Collect & Queue Factory Materials, and Upgrade Two Homes

when_to_do_it.trigger_condition: When all 5 Small Factories finish producing Metal/Wood and residential buildings have ready hard hats.
when_to_do_it.strategic_reasoning: Checking 'Busy Manufacturing' confirms that only 'Reach City Level 4' remains to claim the next chest, motivating residential upgrades using the freshly collected Metal and Wood.
preconditions: Finished Metal and Wood on the 5 Small Factories
Ready hard hats on residential zones
when_to_do_it.placement_rule: Collect all factory output, re-queue Metal and Wood, and apply materials to the two ready residential zones.

steps.who: City Journal icon on the bottom-left
steps.briefing: open 'Busy Manufacturing' and click 'Show more' to check progress, then close.

steps.who: floating Metal icons across the northern Small Factories
steps.briefing: collect all finished Metal and re-queue Metal in the first four factories and Wood in the fifth factory.

steps.who: yellow hard hat on the lower-left residential house
steps.briefing: drag Metal (20/1) and Wood (2/1) onto the house to upgrade it.

steps.who: yellow hard hat on the lower-right Residential Zone
steps.briefing: drag Wood (1/1) and Nails (1/1) onto the zone to construct it.
